headword: {玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}
gloss: a mix of good and bad; wheat and chaff together

definitions.gloss: good and bad mixed together; mixed quality
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom, literally "jewels and stones mixed together": a collection in which excellent things and worthless things are jumbled together, so that the good must be picked out. Also written {玉石混淆|ぎょくせきこんこう}.

examples.japanese: {応募作|おうぼさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}だった。
examples.english: The submissions were a mix of good and bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}だ。
examples.english: Information on the internet is of very mixed quality.

examples.japanese: {玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧コミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧ものを⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need the ability to tell the reliable reviews from the rest in a mixed bag of word-of-mouth.

notes:
Usually a mild criticism: the speaker is warning that not everything in the group is worth trusting. Common with information, reviews, applicants, and new products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}だ: to be of mixed quality
- {玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: information of mixed reliability
- {玉石混交|ぎょくせきこんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to pick from a mixed bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{十人十色|じゅうにんといろ}→十人十色：04770_juunintoiro⟧: tastes differ — about variety of taste, with no judgment of good and bad
- ⟦{千差万別|せんさばんべつ}→千差万別：06245_sensabanbetsu⟧: endless variety — stresses difference, not quality
